honesty_note: The Poissonnier 2026 open-arena outcome and the failure of H2-v1 were known before H3 was specified. This is not a blind preregistration. It freezes a genuinely different mechanism class before implementation or H3 parameter search.
claim: Recent sustained constrained walking transiently lowers the probability per unit distance of a major reorientation event after arena entry, without directly changing speed or the distribution of turn angles conditional on a reorientation.
biological_motivation: Lasius niger locomotion has been modeled as straight runs separated by discrete reorientation events (Boltzmann-walker family).
H2-v1 changed continuous angular diffusion and failed its frozen 5/6 held-out-colony promotion guard.
H3 changes event timing rather than continuously scaling every heading perturbation, creating a distinct and falsifiable trajectory signature.
forbidden_inputs: colony identity as a biological control input

baseline_walk.description: Piecewise ballistic motion with ordinary speed dynamics and pauses retained from the existing locomotion substrate, but large directional changes occur through explicit stochastic reorientation events rather than continuous Gaussian angular diffusion.
baseline_walk.event_process: Treat reorientations as a continuous-time hazard process, not one Bernoulli draw per physics tick. Maintain an exponential unit-hazard threshold, integrate h_turn through elapsed motion, resolve a threshold crossing at sub-step time, apply the turn at that time, and continue the remainder of the physics step. Draw a fresh threshold after each event; more than one event in a large step must be representable.
baseline_walk.turn_angle_family: symmetric von Mises distribution centered on zero heading change with concentration kappa_turn
baseline_walk.background_major_turns_between_events: none; major changes in direction occur only at reorientation events
baseline_walk.timestep_rule: No probability-per-tick parameter is allowed. Event timing must be sub-step/integrated-hazard based and pass timestep-convergence tests.

latent_state.name: reorientation_gate
latent_state.initialization: G0 = 1 - exp(-L / lambda_history_mm), where L is recent_constrained_travel_mm
latent_state.decay: dG/dt = -G / tau_gate_s; exact step update G(t+dt)=G(t)*exp(-dt/tau_gate_s)
direct_effects_forbidden: turn-angle distribution conditional on a turn

rng_policy.purpose: Adding H3 stochastic events must not consume the baseline locomotion RNG and thereby change speed or pause randomness merely because H3 exists.
rng_policy.baseline_stream_separation: Speed, pause, individual locomotion heterogeneity, protocol, treatment, and observation randomness remain on their pre-existing streams. H3 event-threshold and turn-angle draws use only the dedicated H3 streams.
rng_policy.common_random_numbers_rule: H3-null and H3-context use the same named stream seeds for matched trials. Disabling the history gate changes hazard timing through the model equation, not through unrelated random-number consumption.
rng_policy.future_ablation_rule: Changing observation metadata or H3 logging must not alter H3 event times, turn angles, speed draws, or pause draws.

structural_predictions: Longer recent constrained travel produces a larger G0 and therefore a lower early reorientation-event hazard.
The long-travel condition should have a longer first free path and fewer major reorientation events early after arena entry than the short-travel condition.
Conditional on a major reorientation occurring, the turn-angle distribution must be the same in short and long conditions.
H3 does not directly predict a speed difference between short and long conditions.
G decays toward zero, so path-history effects on reorientation frequency should weaken with time since arena entry.
With recent_constrained_travel_mm = 0 or rho_gate = 0, the H3 context effect disappears exactly.
No centerline or pheromone variable is available to H3, so any central-zone occupancy difference can arise only from geometry and trajectories, not targeted steering.
raw_trajectory_discriminators_if_recover: time and distance from entry to first major reorientation
number of major reorientation events in successive time windows
turn-angle distribution conditional on a reorientation
comparison of H2 continuous heading-increment variance versus H3 discrete event timing

relationship_to_other_hypotheses.H1: H1 remains an unresolved apparatus-entry explanation. H3 may not use treatment-specific entry-heading distributions.
relationship_to_other_hypotheses.H2: H2 continuously reduces angular diffusion. H3 instead modulates only the timing/frequency of discrete major reorientation events.
relationship_to_other_hypotheses.non_equivalence_rule: H3 must not be implemented as a renamed multiplier on angular_sigma_rad_sqrt_s.

required_tests: zero-history equivalence to the context-free H3 walk
integrated-hazard event timing and event-count convergence across dt
sub-step event timing rather than end-of-step turn application
same conditional turn-angle distribution across short/long histories for matched kappa_turn
dedicated H3 event and turn-angle RNG streams do not perturb baseline speed/pause randomness
observation/logging changes do not perturb H3 biological RNG streams
protocol cannot inject G or H3 biological parameters
same H3 biological model hash in short and long assays

evidence_notes.representation_support: Piecewise runs separated by reorientation events is grounded in published Lasius niger random-walk/Boltzmann-walker analyses. This supports the representation, not the specific history-dependent gate.
evidence_notes.history_gate_status: The proposed dependence of reorientation hazard on recent constrained-travel history is a candidate mechanism, not an established biological fact.
